svg.title: FIG-31 F4 source ownership and interface boundaries Each edge distinguishes build inputs from calls; no qualification
svg.desc: io/: public types, requests and borrow contracts; soc/stm32/stm32f4/ Controller C, lifecycle and official SDK adaptation; F4 drivers/ip/: private shared hardware algorithms; vendors/st/: F4 HAL / Device Inventory retained; selected inputs consumed; tests/support/native/ Explicit test scope, not a production SoC; components/: ILI9341 / XPT2046 / W25; Package manifest / facts / bindings Board JSON and external TOML; tools/configure/: generic DataProvider Domain policies, named IR, bounded static assembly; Generated nexus_bindings.c Static instances, faces and fixed lifecycle connections; Runtime: public narrow-port access; Runtime: ops(context); Build: select private source; Build: private include / link; Tests: execute real hardware algorithm C; Build: one input snapshot; Build: emit bounded static connections; Build: private types, fixed C calls and links
